name: spp-commerce
label: SPP commerce rules
description: Companion plugin of the spp-customization theme: B2B account bar, cart and checkout rules, and the store API routes the theme cannot take over.

casePacks.label: Items sold in case packs: { "<SKU>": <pack size> } (quantities are rounded up to whole packs)

orderLimits.label: Per-order limits: { "<SKU>": <max quantity> } (a cart line over its limit is brought back to it)

lineNotes.label: Show case-pack and order-limit notes under cart and checkout lines

showAccountBar.label: Show the account bar above the header
